Rachel Youn creates kinetic sculptures using artificial plants, electric massagers, metal structures, and everyday mechanical parts. Her works often make fake flowers shake, vibrate, and move like living organisms. The movement is simple, but it changes how we see the object. A decorative plant becomes a machine, a body, and a performance at the same time. Her sculptures question the line between nature, technology, decoration, and artificial life.#flower #plant #nature #art #artist

Kosei Komatsu’s Light and Shadow Mobiles Installation: Air and Songs transforms space through dynamic kinetic art. By playing with the delicate balance between light and shadow, Komatsu invites the viewer to experience a visual symphony of movement. His intricate sculptures hang suspended in space, where each turn of the mobile reflects a poetic interplay of air and light, evoking a sense of freedom and harmony. A master of minimalist expression, Komatsu creates an immersive environment where the work evolves in response to its surroundings, inviting introspection and connection to the elemental forces of nature. This exhibition is a celebration of movement, subtle beauty, and the art of transformation. #BaroqueBlended #KoseiKomatsu #Art #Artist #Expressionism #Sculpture #InstallationArt #ContemporaryArt #LightAndShadow #KineticArt #Minimalism #ArtExhibition
